narrative.overview:
A CV that reads like a product site. The page is a white sheet (or a near-black one in dark mode) carrying a tight, heavy grotesk, stone-grey surfaces and hairline-ruled rows; the only color that belongs to the owner is a deep forest green, and it marks the things that matter: the action, the name, the proof figures, the "now" dot. Everything else is ink at three strengths. Density is calm and editorial: generous section spacing (128px), lists that are rows rather than card grids, one idea per row, a metric at the end of every service.

The owner's own products are the one place other colors are allowed in. Vesty and Millo Manager each enter as a guest brand inside a stone card: Vesty as a teal/purple phone mockup, Millo Manager as a red/gold Barlow Condensed player card with a real photo. The guests keep their identity; the host card stays neutral around them.

Motion is present but quiet: a single orchestrated settle on the hero, blur-in reveals on scroll, figures that count up, a pointer tilt and spotlight on the photo and product cards, a career track that draws itself, a sheen across primary buttons, a 2px reading-progress bar. All of it disappears under reduced motion and nothing depends on JS to be visible. The site is bilingual (ES default, EN toggle in the nav) and every surface must hold both languages' lengths.
keyCharacteristics: White / near-black canvas, stone surfaces, ink text in three strengths.
One brand color, forest green, used only for action, emphasis and proof.
Schibsted Grotesk throughout at tight negative tracking; JetBrains Mono only for years and periods.
Pills for every control (nav, buttons, toggles, capability pills); 28px for every large surface.
Hairline-ruled rows instead of card grids for services, experience and content.
Guest brands (Vesty, Millo Manager) render in their own palettes inside neutral host cards.
Soft motion with a single ease (`cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`), fully disabled by `prefers-reduced-motion`.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Forest green is the only owner color. It marks action, the name, proof and state; it is never a background wash for a section, never a gradient, and never used for body text.

rules.name: The Guest Brand Rule
rules.body: A product's own palette and typeface stay inside its card. Nothing outside the Vesty or Millo Manager card borrows teal, purple, red, gold or Barlow Condensed, and inside the card the host button turns ink-black so the green never competes with the guest.

rules.name: The Dark Mode Is Its Own Green Rule
rules.body: Dark mode does not reuse #1F5F4A; it swaps to sage (fills) and brighter sage (text), and the closing card goes to Night Pine.

rules.name: The Mono Is For Time Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears only on years, periods and dated meta (plus the Vesty mockup's change chip). Never for headings, labels or decoration.

rules.name: The Tight Heavy Rule
rules.body: Anything 2rem and up is 700 with -0.035em to -0.04em tracking and line-height at or under 1.04.

rules.name: The Rows Not Cards Rule
rules.body: Services, experience, education and content are hairline-ruled rows on the canvas. Cards are reserved for the owner's products and the closing call to action.

rules.name: The Objects Cast Shadows Rule
rules.body: Only depicted objects (photo, phone, player card) and the floating nav cast shadows; rows, sections, buttons and cards stay flat. Object shadows are long, soft and negative-spread, tinted by the object's own brand.

dos: **Do** use forest green (#1F5F4A light; sage #6fae93 fill / #7fbfa3 text in dark) for primary actions, the last line of the H1, proof figures, tags, dots, capability pills and the closing card, and nowhere else.
**Do** anchor every service row to a real figure in the proof column.
**Do** keep controls as full pills (100px) and large surfaces at 28px.
**Do** list services, roles, education and posts as hairline-ruled rows.
**Do** show the owner's products in their own brand inside a neutral Stone card, with the card's primary button in ink.
**Do** use Simple Icons marks through a `currentColor` mask in the marquee, and an outlined monogram when a tool has no public mark.
**Do** keep every animation behind `prefers-reduced-motion` and keep content visible without JS.
**Do** make every new string work in both ES and EN.
donts: **Don't** add a second owner accent, a gradient in the owner's green, or a green section background outside the closing card.
**Don't** let Vesty or Millo Manager colors or Barlow Condensed leak outside their cards.
**Don't** use JetBrains Mono for anything but years, periods and dated meta.
**Don't** put shadows on rows, buttons, sections or product cards; shadows belong to depicted objects and the scrolled nav.
**Don't** add skill bars, emoji, glow orbs or decorative blobs; the thesis rejects the dev-portfolio template.
**Don't** add small uppercase labels above section titles; section heads are a headline and an intro.
**Don't** use filled or emoji icons; extend the 1.6-stroke line set instead.
**Don't** fabricate testimonials, client logos, prices or user numbers to fill a surface.
